analysis_notes.message: Flower calibration uses median LAB from every sampled marker patch. Median sampling reduces the influence of isolated outlier pixels and matches the Python GUI workflow. Standard 24 also uses median patch sampling.
b* = -10.392 * pH^2 + 82.361 * pH - 96.528; solve with the minus square root branch.
Urea model selection: nearest of 6.0 6.5 7.0 midpoint ties lower.
p = 1 / (1 + exp(6.28 - 0.25 * urea_mM - 0.15 * creatinine_uM - 0.03 * age_years + 0.42 * male_indicator)); classify as Predicted G3+ when p >= 0.305, otherwise Predicted G1-2.
Reservoir LAB is the arithmetic mean of the calibrated median LAB values from its ROI results. Each ROI median reduces the influence of isolated outlier pixels and matches the Python GUI workflow.
A reservoir may use 1 to 4 ROI results. Reservoir LAB is the arithmetic mean of the calibrated median LAB values from the available ROIs.
One complete in-range reservoir is sufficient for an analyte result and is included automatically. Out-of-range results require review.
When multiple complete reservoirs for one analyte are included, their calculated concentrations are combined using the confirmed arithmetic mean aggregation.

Configured result ranges: pH 6.000 to 7.000; urea 0.000 to 500.000 mM; creatinine 0.000 to 200.000 µM. Complete valid in-range reservoirs are included automatically. Out-of-range values are not clamped and require manual review.
CKD prediction was not calculated. A final urea value, final creatinine value, valid age, and sex are required.
